name: @aggrega-ai/aggrega-pdk-typescript
description: Plugin Development Kit for authoring Aggrega Wasm plugins in TypeScript.

scripts.check-pack-contents: node -e "const {execFileSync}=require('child_process');const pkg=require('./package.json');const want=[pkg.main,pkg.types].map(p=>p.replace('./','')).concat('LICENSE');const have=JSON.parse(execFileSync('npm',['pack','--dry-run','--json','--ignore-scripts'],{encoding:'utf8'}))[0].files.map(f=>f.path);const missing=want.filter(p=>!have.includes(p));if(missing.length){console.error('packed tarball omits its declared entry point or licence text: '+missing.join(', '));process.exit(1);}console.log('packed tarball carries '+want.join(' and ')+' ('+have.length+' files)');"
scripts.test: npm run check-pack-contents && node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/round_trip.test.ts tests/describe.test.ts tests/parse_source_wire.test.ts tests/source_wire.test.ts tests/fetch_wire.test.ts
